name: kldload workspace keys
description: Adds the two window actions GNOME cannot bind natively. (1) 'move this window to workspace N and follow it there' — sending without following is already possible with the stock move-to-workspace-N bindings; going with it is not, because mutter only activates the target workspace for the relative/directional variants, which cannot express an absolute compass layout. (2) 'tile every window on this workspace into a grid' — mutter exposes toggle-tiled-left/right only, which is one window and a half screen; nothing in any GNOME version arranges four windows into four quarters. Shell-version range covers the ESM extension format (GNOME 45+) through 50. The maximize state is read from the maximized-horizontally/vertically properties rather than a getter because mutter 18 dropped get_maximized() in favour of is_maximized(), so no single getter spells correctly across the whole range. Verified loading on 48 (Debian trixie) and 50 (Fedora).
